items.name: SacCubing VI 2019
items.information: ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) It's finally here! Sacramento's big annual winter competition is coming! Be sure to reserve your registration now! The event will be in Bonner Gym at Del Oro High School. **This venue is different from past venues that have held SacCubing in the past.** All competitors must be available to judge/run/scramble for the competition as per Regulation [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). All competitors will be expected to help by judging or running for any event they are doing. Nametags will be handed out with all the information regarding what groups you will be competing in and what groups you will be helping in. If you are not competing in an event, you will not be assigned to help during that event.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup I 2019
items.information: SC Cup I is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2019, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2019/?lang=en for the details of the other editions. A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Der SC Cup I ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2019. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2019/. Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Le SC Cup I fait partie du Swisscubing Cup 2019, qui consiste de 6 compétitions tout au long de l'année. Allez voir sur https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2019/?lang=fr pour plus d'informations sur les autres autres manches. Un compétiteur qui s'inscrit et ne vient pas à la compétition (sans nous l'annoncer à l'avance) devra payer des frais d'inscription supplémentaires à sa prochaine compétition en Suisse. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ SC Cup I da parte della Swisscubing Cup 2019, che è composta da 6 competizioni tenute durante l'anno. Qui (https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2019/?lang=it) trovi le informazioni relative alle altre edizioni. Un partecipante che si iscrive a una competizione ma non si presenta deve pagare la tassa di iscrizione alla sua prossima competizione in Svizzera.

items.name: Utah Valley Open 2019

venue.name: Spanish Fork Fairgrounds Ponderosa Buliding
venue.address: 2409, 475 S Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660
venue.details: The venue is located just north of the High Chaparral Building in the Spanish Fork Fairgrounds.

items.information: * Cubes will be sold at the competition by Oliver's Twisted Puzzles. * There will be a 100 person competitor limit. It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Volunteers have to clean the venue afterward, so please be careful with outside food and drink. * Parking is avalable in front of the High Chapperal Building on the Spanish Fork Fairgrounds and is free for the whole day. * Registration is online only. No at the door registrations will be accepted. * Registration is not considered complete until payment has been accepted. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) provides the information you need.
